snippet.title: Super Metroid: Recovery #1
snippet.description: This is the beginning of a Super Metroid ROM hack I am making known as Super Metroid: Recovery. It is the first hack I have ever made, so I am still learning how to use SMILE. Due to this, mistakes are likely to be made. (16:27, 19:40)This is not the entire hack that I have completed so far, but this is what I decided to upload at this current point, as the rest needs a bit of polishing. I hope you enjoy and will come back when I release part 2! Note: This is not by any stretch of the imagination the final version of this hack, any or all portions of this hack are subject to change. The forum thread for this hack can be found at http://forum.metroidconstruction.com/index.php/topic,4476.0.html
